description: Defines a template class 'batched_dispatch_queue' that batches values and dispatches them via a task executor, including methods for pushing, stopping, and handling enqueued values.

classes.name: batched_dispatch_queue
classes.description: A template class that manages batching of values and dispatches them asynchronously using a task executor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the queue, drains remaining values, and prevents further pushes.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue a value; dispatches a dequeue task if the queue transitions from empty to non-empty.

methods.name: size_approx
methods.description: Returns an approximate size of the enqueued values.

methods.name: handle_enqueued_values
methods.description: Processes and batches enqueued values, dispatching them via callback.

methods.name: dispatch_value_dequeue_task
methods.description: Dispatches a task to dequeue and process batched values.

methods.name: drain_queue
methods.description: Drains all remaining values in the queue during shutdown.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Helper function to block and attempt to pop a value from the queue with a timeout.
